title: Fix the flaky Live playback browser test (route.fetch after test end)
objective: The fictional member browser journey no longer fails at random: route handlers that fetch from the server finish or are ignored before a Live playback test tears down
next_action: Merge PR #3 once validate, runtime and governance pass; fast-forward main, restart arbit-worker; remove the merged worktree and local branches (TASK-009 next step); then M3 slice 3 with weather W1.

review.summary: Run 45089822359 (Runtime validation, push, e944420) failed in 'Run fictional member browser journey': live-playback.spec.ts:281 'a partial replay draws the verified action and explains what is unknown' threw 'route.fetch: Test ended. Consider awaiting page.unrouteAll({ behavior: ignoreErrors })'. The pull_request run of the same commit passed; main d9f95ec passed. openPlayback routes **/plays?* through route.fetch() to the real server, and the page re-requests plays as the stubbed event stream reconnects (retry: 50), so a fetch can be in flight when the last assertion passes. Spec from 8074c8f; no afterEach or unroute anywhere in tests/browser.

plan.summary: Add test.afterEach that awaits page.unrouteAll({ behavior: 'ignoreErrors' }) in live-playback.spec.ts. Prove locally on an isolated stack: scratch DB arbit_browser_fixture (seeded by arbit_api.fixture), client built to a scratch outDir, API on 127.0.0.1:8011, Playwright via ARBIT_BASE_URL and the installed headless shell; run the spec with --repeat-each before (expect at least one Test ended failure) and after (expect none). Then web-check and foundation; CI reruns the full browser journey.

implementation.summary: Added test.afterEach awaiting page.unrouteAll({ behavior: 'ignoreErrors' }) with a comment on the cause (7 lines, live-playback.spec.ts). Isolated stack: scratch DB arbit_browser_fixture seeded by arbit_api.fixture, client built to scratchpad outDir, API on 127.0.0.1:8011, owner app on :8000 untouched. Without the fix: --repeat-each 40 passed 200/200 (race too rare locally); with a temporary random 0-1200 ms delay before route.fetch, 22 failed / 38 passed and 21 errors were exactly 'route.fetch: Test ended.'; with the fix and the same delay, 60/60 passed. Delay removed (no TEMPORARY lines); full browser suite 16 passed. Status and changelog updated.

validation.summary: Observed exit 0: foundation; web-check (Biome lint and format, typecheck, Vitest, build, PWA); browser-suite-isolated (full Playwright suite, 16 tests, against the isolated fixture stack on :8011). Reproduction evidence in implementation. Isolated API stopped and scratch database dropped afterwards; owner app :8000 returned 200 throughout. CI reruns the browser journey on push and PR.

journal.note: The race reproduces only when a route.fetch is in flight as teardown begins; a fixed 1.5 s delay did not reproduce it (the callback woke after the page closed), a random 0-1200 ms delay did (21 exact errors in 60 runs).
